address_bar:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: decorative Candy Browser address-bar settings illustration.
Primary request: Create ONE polished flat Material Expressive illustration matching the supplied existing Candy Browser header artwork. The references are STYLE references only, not edit targets. Show the two address-bar constructions as a balanced compact composition: upper a single continuous rounded capsule with a simple small padlock at left, one short thick horizontal line in middle, and three tiny menu dots at right; lower a segmented bar consisting of a separate small rounded-square tab button with a simple overlapping-card symbol, a small white gap, then a long capsule with padlock and short horizontal line. Both rows have the same total width. Subtle difference in tones, strong legibility at mobile header size. These are abstract browser controls, no text or actual URL.
Style/medium: precise flat 2D graphic, broad confidently rounded silhouettes, monochrome black and neutral light/mid gray tones, same restrained Material Expressive shape language and slight paper character as reference artwork.
Composition/framing: landscape 1536 by 1024, centered, two evenly spaced horizontal forms occupying central 75% width and central 55% height; generous clean white margins around entire motif. All shapes fully contained. No enclosing browser window, no outer colored rectangular panel.
Scene/backdrop: opaque clean white paper.
Constraints: grayscale only so runtime can recolor black to theme primary and white to page surface; keep all border pixels white. Clear white negative space. No words, letters, numbers, watermark, branding, arrows, gradients, shadows, 3D, perspective, device frames or decorative sparkles.
